issue_context.title: Add index cardinality info in the `show index` statement
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
Now the cardinality is always zero in the result of `show index` statement.
https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/7c3a22e48db9c866f1d5f983a81b4e183daa00e1/executor/show.go#L806 . It is hard code here. 
I think there is cardinality in the statistics. Can you replace the hard code data with the real data?

review_comments: Not a big problem, but `if colStats != nil` is safer.
I think it's a rare problem. Just missed the comment this time.
